title: SdpOffer
description: Relayed verbatim between peers. The server never parses the SDP -- only encrypted-handshake metadata passes through signaling (CLAUDE.md invariant).

sessionId.description: Must name a live session the sender participates in; anything else is an `error` with `unknownSession`.

sdp.description: Opaque SDP blob, including the DTLS fingerprint and ICE ufrag/pwd generated by the WebRTC stack.
